objective: Make the Electron app a runnable local dashboard with real text chat plus moderated TTS playback, visible hover Voice control on the transparent widget, and a start command that brings up the loopback control plane without offline polling spam.
non_goals: Do not expose arbitrary HTTP, filesystem, shell or Node access to the renderer.
Do not fake chat or voice output when the local model or TTS provider is unavailable.
Do not add deep repeat, soak or release verification in this fast iteration.
contracts: Renderer calls only named preload methods backed by allowlisted loopback paths.
Text chat uses the existing conversation service and shows real completed, interrupted or failed outcomes.
Voice playback uses the existing moderated VieNeu TTS endpoint and respects global mute.
The transparent widget shows no controls at rest and exposes one Voice toggle on hover/focus.
Offline polling uses bounded exponential backoff and start:desktop auto-starts the local control plane when needed.
allowed_dependencies: Existing Electron, Vue, local control-plane chat and TTS APIs.
acceptance_criteria: Desktop typecheck/build and security tests pass.
Chat page can start and cancel a real turn, display assistant text and request real WAV playback.
Widget Voice button remains no-drag and becomes visible on hover/focus.
start:desktop starts one hidden control-plane helper only when health is unavailable.
Control-plane offline errors back off instead of being emitted every 250 milliseconds.
